09110.name: Capitol Planning Region
09110.description: Hartford and its suburbs bring nearly a million people, busy roads, homes and major employers into the Capitol region. When Connecticut gets a run of hot summer days, that large urban population leaves a lot of people exposed to extreme heat.

09120.name: Greater Bridgeport Planning Region
09120.description: Greater Bridgeport combines dense city neighborhoods with factories, hospitals and homes along Long Island Sound. Summer heat affects a lot of people in a small area, while the shoreline puts waterfront buildings in the path of coastal storms.
